name: admin-credentials
description: Admin login credentials and platform configuration for The Shelf psychology book builder. Used to access the admin panel at /admin.

pricing.infiniteUsageNote: Set Generations Per Token to 0 for unlimited usage. Tokens still expire after the configured expiry period but allow unlimited generations within that window.

paymentProvider.behavior: When payment provider is set to 'paystack', paid token creation generates a Paystack payment link instead of recording a simulated payment. Set to 'none' to allow only free admin-created tokens.

tokenSystem.freeTokens: Admins can create tokens for free (no payment recorded) using the 'free' flag in the token creation modal.
tokenSystem.infiniteUsage: Set Generations Per Token to 0 for unlimited usage (token stores 999999 max_uses internally; validation treats it as unlimited). Token still expires after expiry period.
tokenSystem.tokenValidation: Tokens are validated via POST /api/tokens/validate before book generation. Usage is incremented on each generation.
tokenSystem.paymentCheck: Paid tokens require a configured payment provider (Paystack). If no provider is configured, attempting to create a paid token returns HTTP 402.

notes: These credentials are synced with the ADMIN_EMAIL and ADMIN_PASSWORD env vars in .env.local.
At first run, db.ts auto-creates the default admin using these values if no admin exists.
If an admin already exists in the database, these env vars will NOT overwrite it — run scripts/update-admin-password.js to change the password.
The admin password is hashed with Argon2 before storage. Only the hash is persisted in the SQLite database.
All admin API routes are protected — non-admin users receive 403 Forbidden.
The admin panel uses a sidebar layout with links to Dashboard, Tokens, Users, Payments, and Pricing pages.
Paystack secret key is masked in API responses (shows •••••••• + last 4 chars).
